reason: Both memos hit every hard requirement (headings, exactly 5 bullets, word count, closing sentence) equally well, but Response B's 'What could go wrong' section engages more honestly and concretely with the strongest objection — naming the actual CI failure mode (40-minute flaky suite, ignored red builds) rather than hedging with 'if our test suite has blind spots' as Response A does — making its acknowledgment of risk more credible and specific.
